summary: Complete initial source-scope chronology audit of all 66 Chinese units, all 101 temporal or active-hint items, and all 29 people. The ritual-guard treatise juxtaposes institutional history, retrospective narrative, reign references, accession and death notices, and dated ceremonies. Every extracted date and hint is conservatively retained as a source-grounded research hold: independent source-critical review is required before any reign span, conversion, or event context is approved as a personal life or activity date. No source or extraction data was changed.
